description: Pinned off-scope samples used by TestCheckQuestion_OffScopeSamples in input_test.go. Each `question` must be detected as input_off_scope by CheckQuestion. These are the obvious wins — bare greetings, shell commands, SQL/XSS payloads, arithmetic, translate / joke / weather requests, DB enumeration. Fuzzier off-topic questions (e.g. "what is the company's stock price?") are intentionally not in this list — those fall through to the RAG path and surface as not_covered.

cases.question: Show me a list of all users in the database.
Write me a Python script to scrape this website.
Translate this to French: hello world
